remedy.notes: $7,500 on counsel + $2,500 on client = $10,000; metadata showed filings originated from client's AI program; first NY appellate-level GenAI sanctions decision. Source is the New York Official Reports slip opinion (official reporter, HTML). Tooling note: nycourts.gov returns HTTP 403 to bare scripted requests but 200 to a browser-like User-Agent, so an automated link-check failure here is a known false negative; both the bare and www hosts serve the document.
